notes.title: Leaderboards are working!
notes.content:
I knew leaderboards were required for Crystal Flux and since Steam is my focus for launch, I decided upon Steam Leaderboards. After 2 weeks of programming, completely out of my area of expertise, and a weekend of bugs; the leaderboards are now up and running!!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=864183679

It defaults to the global leaderboard and there is also a button for friends only so check it out!

Tips for climbing the leaderboard:

    prioritize orbs
    jump and go upside down as much as possible
    don't run into trees, bushes, or crystals (you won't be able to pick up orbs for 1.5 seconds)


Also free free to brag about your score or taunt others on our  Discord Server

(hotkey F12 to snap screenshots)
